notes.title: NekoDice 1.0.1.37 Update
notes.content:
Update Live2D SDK to R5
Will get link achievement when open software

notes.title: 1.0.1.30 Small Update
notes.content: Added support for MouthPucker, MouthPuff, MouthX

notes.title: 1.0.1.28 Small Update
notes.content:
Added support for iUSB connection (requires Shiori 2.0.7 or later)
Added language data for tr (Thanks to @DeathTurk)

notes.title: 1.0.1.27 Bug fix
notes.content:
Fix:
Fixed the bug when user uploading the model.

Improve:
Moved all collider modify functions into "Collider Settings" in "Model Config"
Moved the widget switch to the left corner of the main panel.

notes.title: 1.0.1.24 Small Update
notes.content:
Improve:
Improved widget
Gift size support

notes.title: 1.0.1.23 Small Update
notes.content:
Add:
1. Anchor system, now you can move your model quickly to fit your live settings.
2. Disable gift is now available
3. Added support for model-side reverse eye

notes.title: 1.0.1.22 patches
notes.content:
fixed the bug caused in link
added the button for fase device UDID reset

notes.title: 1.0.1.21 Small update
notes.content:
Added lost reset switch
Added new algorithm

notes.title: 1.0.1.19 Big update
notes.content:
Fix:
Fix linkeye in OSF tracker
Fix speed adjustion in shortcut

Improve:
Added global shortcut switch
Added custom parameters
Added switch for default parameters

notes.title: 1.0.1.17 Big Update
notes.content:
Added shortcut for quick UI hide &show.
Added quick model selection window.
Improved collider modify function.

notes.title: 1.0.1.16 Small Update
notes.content:
Added support to launch without steam(by using launch_without_steam.bat)
Improved the UI in link window.
Improved the eye tracking of OSF. (This change may rollback later)

notes.title: 1.0.1.15 Small update
notes.content:
Improved gift particle system.
Added model bounciness.

notes.title: 1.0.1.14 Small update
notes.content:
Improved the model logic, now you can select the model when you press "+" without model dropdown selection
Improved mouse logic, now you can use ParamMouseX and ParamMouseY to simulate the mouse position (From -1 to 1, same as ParamEyeBallX and ParamEyeBallY)

notes.title: 1.0.1.13 Update
notes.content:
Improved OpenSeeFace（OSF）tracker
Improved UI

Add support to use mouse position as eyeX & eyeY

notes.title: 1.0.1.10 Small bug fix
notes.content:
Fix：
fix the bug caused by background image
fix the font error when setting the shortcut

Improve：
Improved the selection of shortcut and widget

notes.title: 1.0.1.9 Small Update
notes.content:
Added support for mosaic widgets.
Improved the hint when you have not connect or select the model UDID.
Add hint when you press + button without select the model.
